resources.string: Switch between computer and mobile keyboard
Voice input is off in password and private fields.
Offline voice input is not available.
No offline voice model for this language. Import it in Settings → Offline models.
Allow microphone access in Settings to use voice input.
Keyboard is enabled in system settings
Keyboard is the current input method

1. Open the keyboard settings and turn on “Offline Computer Keyboard”. 2. Tap “Choose keyboard” and select it. Android shows a standard warning for every third-party keyboard; this one has no network access.
Type here to test the keyboard
Reopen in the last used mode
Cursor keys row in mobile mode
Swipe the space bar to change language
The app has no internet permission

No server, no account, no analytics. Typed text and audio are not stored or logged. Your dictionary (if you turn learning on), settings and models stay on this device and are excluded from cloud backup.
Restore all keyboard settings to their defaults?
Change language: the 🌐 key, the language button above the keys, swiping the space bar, or a shortcut (default Alt+Shift and Win+Space in computer mode).

Shortcuts work in computer mode. Tap the modifiers (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win) and then the key. A combination of modifiers only (for example Alt+Shift) runs when no other key follows within half a second, so Alt+Shift+letter still works.
Choose Ctrl, Alt or Win with a key, or at least two modifiers without a key.
This replaces a standard command (copy, paste, undo …).
Runs half a second after the last modifier if no key follows.
Off by default. Single words are stored on this phone only, with a use count — never whole messages. Nothing is learned in password, private (incognito), e-mail and address fields.
Suggestions come from your dictionary and appear above the keys. Tap to insert, long-press to remove the word.
Only letters, apostrophe and hyphen; 2–40 characters.
…and %1$d more. Use search to find them.
Delete the whole dictionary in all languages?
Voice input and translation run on this phone with model files you import from a local .zip file. The app never downloads anything.
Importing %1$s… this can take a minute.
One model per language. Small models (40–150 MB) are recommended for phones.
A package for each direction. The direction is detected from the file.

Voice: vosk-model-small-uk-v3-small.zip, vosk-model-small-pl-0.22.zip, vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.zip from alphacephei.com/vosk/models. Translation: offline-keyboard-mt-uk-pl.zip and offline-keyboard-mt-pl-uk.zip from the project\'s “Offline Keyboard Models” build. Download them on any device, copy to this phone (for example to Downloads) and tap Import.
Allow the microphone in the app settings to use voice input.
Say “кома”, “крапка”, “знак питання”, “новий рядок” (Polish: “przecinek”, “kropka”, “znak zapytania”, “nowa linia”; English: “comma”, “period”, “question mark”, “new line”).
Translation is not available in this field.
No offline model for %1$s. Import it in Settings → Offline models.
The text changed during translation; nothing was replaced.

Tap ⇄ above the keys. Type (or dictate) in the source language: the text stays underlined. Enter (⇄) replaces it with the translation. Moving the cursor keeps the typed text unchanged. Long-press ⇄ to swap the direction.
